reviewer.separation: execution and context only; Codex unavailable (usage limit until 2026-10-24)

previous_round.R10-F02: fixed in governedReleaseWitness (ValidateReleaseVersion filter); neighbour in the status not covered, see R11-F01
previous_round.R10-F03: fixed (GitNotARepository proves .git absent on every ancestor; TestR10ALostGitdirIsNotNoRepository)

blocking.title: status lists every SemVer tag of a project that never adopted governed releases as a prepared release with a gap
requirements: constraint: do not adopt policy automatically

repro.fixture: pose install into a fresh repo (scaffolded release policy with adopted_at=""), commit, tags v1.0.0 v1.1.0 v2.0.0

followups_low_new.title: a broken tag ref (garbage loose ref, malformed packed-refs line) resolves as ErrReleaseTagMissing
followups_low_new.repro: adoptedTaggedRelease + garbage refs/tags/v1.0.0: status prepared without gaps, checker errors=0; git prints 'ignoring broken ref' (loose) or nothing (packed)
followups_low_new.why_low: needs corruption of Git's ref store; the state only goes down (no tag), an events journal that records tagged still fails

followups_low_new.title: GitNotARepository does not consider GIT_DIR
followups_low_new.repro: GIT_DIR=<lost> and no .git on any ancestor: gitUnavailableAt=true, checker errors=0 with the inventory removed
followups_low_new.why_low: the loss is in the process environment, not in the project; two losses needed

followups_low_new.title: governedReleaseWitness fails pose check on a SemVer tag that points at a tree or blob (e.g. v2.6.11-tree)
followups_low_new.repro: no release policy, tag v2.6.11-tree -> HEAD^{tree}: 'whether the project adopted governed releases could not be told'
followups_low_new.why_low: fail-closed, rare tag shape, and a project without the policy file already fails the scaffold reference check

followups_low_new.title: previous_version is validated but not re-derived nor disclosed as a limit
followups_low_new.why_low: only a deliberate edit that also recomputes release_input_digest escapes; no state is raised

followups_low_new.title: release check drops ForeignFragmentClaims when the archive or the specs cannot be read (pre-existing)
followups_low_new.why_low: the archive loss is a gap of checkRelease; pose check keeps the structural claim check

probes: isolated copy under /tmp (git archive HEAD), probe file not versioned
